title: Block Env in Git Add
summary: A Claude Code hook that stops git add from staging .env files, private keys and credential files, and checks wildcard adds against .gitignore.
description: Once a secret is committed it lives in history for good. This PreToolUse hook reads each git add command and refuses names such as .env, .env.production, id_rsa, server.pem or credentials.json. Template files like .env.example are fine.
For broad commands such as git add . or git add -A, it lists the working folder and asks git check-ignore about every secret-looking file. Only files that are not ignored trigger the block.
useWhen: Let an agent stage and commit on its own
Work in a repo whose .gitignore is incomplete
Keep service account keys out of pull requests
Guard a project that uses local dotenv files

hook.command: node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c).on('end',()=>{let j={};try{j=JSON.parse(d)||{}}catch(e){process.exit(0)}const i=j.tool_input||{};const q=String.fromCharCode(34),sq=String.fromCharCode(39),bs=String.fromCharCode(92),nl=String.fromCharCode(10);const fs=require('fs'),cp=require('child_process');const sec=n=>{n=n.toLowerCase();return(/^[.]env([.].+)?$/.test(n)&&!/[.](example|sample|template|dist|defaults?)$/.test(n))||/[.](pem|key|p12|pfx|jks|keystore|ppk)$/.test(n)||/^id_(rsa|dsa|ecdsa|ed25519)$/.test(n)||/^(credentials([.](json|ya?ml|xml))?|secrets?[.](json|ya?ml|toml)|[.]netrc|[.]pgpass|[.]htpasswd|service-account.*[.]json)$/.test(n)};for(const sg of String(i.command||'').split(/[;&|]+/)){const a=sg.trim().split(/[ ]+/).map(t=>t.split(q).join('').split(sq).join(''));const k=a.indexOf('add');if(a[0]!=='git'||k<0)continue;const args=a.slice(k+1).filter(t=>t&&t!=='--');let bad=args.filter(t=>t[0]!=='-').map(t=>t.split(bs).join('/').split('/').pop()).find(sec);if(!bad&&args.some(t=>['.','./','*','-A','--all',':/'].indexOf(t)>=0)){try{const cwd=j.cwd||process.cwd();for(const n of fs.readdirSync(cwd)){if(sec(n)&&cp.spawnSync('git',['check-ignore','-q',n],{cwd}).status===1&&cp.spawnSync('git',['ls-files','--',n],{cwd,encoding:'utf8'}).stdout.trim()==='')bad=n}}catch(e){}}if(bad){console.error('Blocked: git add would stage '+bad+', which looks like a secret. Add it to .gitignore, stage the other files by name, and keep real values out of the repository.');process.exit(2)}}})"

example.prompt: Stage everything and commit it as the first version.
example.result: git add . is refused because .env.local is not ignored. The agent adds it to .gitignore and stages the remaining files.

faq.question: Does it look inside subfolders on git add .?
faq.answer: Only the top level of the working folder is scanned. Files named directly on the command line are checked wherever they live.

faq.question: Why is .env.example allowed?
faq.answer: Names ending in .example, .sample, .template or .dist are skipped, since those files normally carry dummy values and belong in the repo.

access: Inspects git add commands and lists the working folder
Runs git check-ignore, which only reads repository rules
Blocks the add; stages and commits nothing
